theme.title: Rotation: Value/Defensives → Growth
theme.summary: Technology (+4.41%) and Materials (+1.66%) led the market today, while Utilities (-0.53%) and Health Care (-0.38%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +1.84% versus -0.20% for defensives and +0.72% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +1.87%, Dow +1.87%, Nasdaq +2.59% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +1.92%. The VIX rose 4.29% to 16.54, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold added 0.88% to $4,144.30, crude oil was little changed at $75.93, and bitcoin gained 0.96% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
